source_evidence.claim: Exact source includes runtime iteration handling, full CSR kernel and persistent timed routine whose inner loop repeats the work.

compiled_evidence.claim: The measured main directly calls GOMP_parallel with the persistent worker and runtime count. The complete worker retains counted iterations with a barrier per pass, a complete disjoint static row partition, vectorized groups of eight nonzeros plus guarded scalar tails, reduction and all row stores.
